risk: Key vendor fails to deliver lab instruments before go-live
mitigation: Dual-source critical instruments; penalty clause in contract

risk: Scope creep from late stakeholder change requests
mitigation: Change control board; impact assessment before approval

risk: Data migration errors corrupt historical lab records

mitigation: Penetration test before launch; encryption at rest and in transit
Documented handovers; cross-train a backup for every critical role

risk: Cold-chain power outage spoils stored samples
mitigation: Backup generator tested monthly; excursion SOP in place

risk: Regulatory audit finds gaps in traceability records
mitigation: Mock audit in Q4; traceability drill every quarter

risk: Users resist the new system and revert to spreadsheets
mitigation: Super-user network; training + floor support in first 4 weeks

risk: Budget overrun from unplanned integration work
Third-party API outage blocks result imports
mitigation: Local retry queue; manual import fallback procedure

risk: Inaccurate requirements cause rework in two modules
mitigation: Prototype sign-off before build; requirements freeze gate

risk: Delayed regulatory approval pushes go-live by a quarter
mitigation: Early submission; weekly follow-up with regulator

risk: Poor data quality in legacy records slows migration
mitigation: Cleansing sprint before migration; data quality dashboard

risk: Single point of failure: only one trained admin
mitigation: Train a second admin before go-live; runbook documented

risk: Extreme weather disrupts sample transport routes
mitigation: Alternate routes pre-agreed; temperature loggers on every shipment
